clue.text: Adapted to established woodland

parts.note: something made for a purpose is adapted to it, so this gives the word for
est. is the usual abbreviation for established, as on shop signs

explanation.surface: Something has been altered to suit long-standing woodland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Adapted' looks like an anagram signal, but 'Adapted to' simply gives FOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A large area covered with trees is a stretch of woodland, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: Series of projections covering sierra journey

parts.note: a film is a thin covering layer
Sierra is the radio alphabet word for S
a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A slide show is screened on a mountain trek.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of film carrying still images shown one after another is a run of projected pictures.

clue.text: Coach again is wet with downpour, perhaps

parts.note: to ret flax or hemp is to soak it in water, so ret means wet
a downpour is one example of rain, hence 'perhaps'

explanation.surface: A sports coach gets soaked in a cloudburst.
explanation.walkthrough: RET is a rare verb: to soak flax so its fibres loosen.
explanation.definitionFit: To coach someone again is to give them fresh training, which is what the verb means.

clue.text: Vote on being in state and part of Germany

indicators.note: the vote and 'on' are placed within the word for state

parts.note: to state is to say
a voter marks the ballot with a cross, X
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone casts a ballot about a German region's status.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a federal state of eastern Germany, whose capital is Dresden.

clue.text: Dirt about celebrity — some hot stuff

indicators.note: the word for dirt goes round the word for celebrity

parts.note: mud is dirt
a star is a celebrity

explanation.surface: Gossip about a famous person is a juicy, spicy story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dirt' and 'hot stuff' both suggest scandal; the hot stuff is a condiment.
explanation.definitionFit: This condiment is pungent and fiery, so it is one example of hot stuff.

clue.text: Your setter — oddly sassy and difficult to deal with

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as me

indicators.note: take the odd-numbered letters of the word sassy

explanation.surface: The compiler admits being cheeky and awkward.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation that is untidy and complicated is hard to handle.

clue.text: Run into woman with desire to be ill-natured

indicators.note: the letter for run goes into the word for woman

parts.note: she stands for a woman
R is the cricket abbreviation for run
a wish is a desire

explanation.surface: Bumping into a woman who wants to be unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrew is a bad-tempered scolding woman, so the adjective means bad-tempered.

clue.text: Keep moving stone with internal magnetism

indicators.note: the word for magnetism is placed inside the word for stone

parts.note: agate is a banded semi-precious stone
it is personal magnetism or sex appeal

explanation.surface: A magnetic stone is kept in motion.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for sex appeal is an old usage: a person with 'it' is magnetic.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir or shake a liquid is to keep it in motion, as a washing machine does.

clue.text: Days on long canal

parts.note: d is the abbreviation for day or days
to long for something is to itch for it

explanation.surface: Someone spends days on a lengthy waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long' reads as an adjective for the canal, but it is the verb meaning yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: A channel dug to carry water is a kind of watercourse, so a ditch is a small canal.

clue.text: Get annoyed about working argument over metal craft

indicators.note: the word for annoy goes round the remaining pieces

parts.note: irk is to annoy, loosely to get annoyed
a machine that is on is working

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the word is turned backwards

parts.note: a row is an argument

explanation.surface: A craftsman grows irritated at an argument over metalwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get annoyed' is loose for the verb irk; in a down clue 'over' means read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorative pieces worked in iron, such as gates and railings, are the products of this metal craft.

clue.text: What might have exuded from trees in former times

definitions.text: What might have exuded from trees

parts.note: the late president means the former president
x is the multiplication sign, read as times

explanation.surface: A historian asks what sap trees produced in earlier ages.
explanation.definitionFit: This milky fluid seeps from rubber trees when they are tapped, so it exudes from trees.

clue.text: Retinue has to remain outside, holding back

indicators.note: the word for remain sits around the word for retinue

parts.note: to rest is to remain
a train is a retinue of attendants

explanation.surface: A royal entourage must wait outside, kept in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-control, the act of keeping oneself in check, is a form of holding back.

clue.text: Nothing happening with girl chasing lone man at an event

indicators.note: the girl's name follows behind the single man

parts.note: a stag is a man going to a social event without a partner
Nancy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl pursues the only unaccompanied man at a party, while nothing happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagnation, a state of inactivity, is when nothing is going on or moving.

clue.text: Anger with rogue husband

parts.note: a rat is a scoundrel

explanation.surface: A wife is furious with her scoundrel of a husband.
explanation.definitionFit: Fury, intense anger, is what this word names.

clue.text: Called to work before golf

indicators.note: the word for work comes ahead of the letter for golf

parts.note: to run a machine is to work it, and a running machine works
Golf is the radio alphabet word for G

explanation.surface: Someone was summoned to their job ahead of a round of golf.
explanation.definitionFit: Called on the telephone is the same as rang up; a phone that has been rung was called.

clue.text: Deign to climb down after deception

indicators.note: the word for climb down follows the word for deception

parts.note: a con is a deception
to descend is to climb down

explanation.surface: After a trick, someone grudgingly backs down.
explanation.definitionFit: To stoop to do something one thinks beneath oneself is to deign, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Family crunched its candy

indicators.note: candy that is crunched is broken up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A family chewed up its sweets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Family' is an adjective here, as in a family business handed down.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to a ruling line of descent, as an adjective, it describes things passed within a family.

clue.text: Tax link limits university with firm obligation

parts.note: a duty is a tax, as on imports

indicators.note: the word for link encloses the letter for university

parts.note: a bond is a link

explanation.surface: Tax rules tie a university to a strict commitment.
explanation.definitionFit: Being bound by duty means being under a firm obligation to do something.

clue.text: Someone grappling with a 12'6" item?

parts.note: a boxer or wrestler who holds an opponent at close quarters is in a clinch; the precise figure suggests a small boat built with overlapping planks

explanation.surface: A sportsman wrestles with an oddly measured object.
explanation.walkthrough: The measurement reads like a length of a boat; clincher-built (clinker-built) boats have overlapping hull planks.
explanation.definitionFit: One who clinches grapples an opponent close; the word also names a boat with overlapping planks.

clue.text: Sight of London and power attracting ancient ruler?

indicators.note: power draws the ancient ruler after it

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics
early means from long ago
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A famous London landmark and its force drew in a monarch of old.
explanation.walkthrough: A Pearly King is a London costermonger leader dressed in a suit covered in mother-of-pearl buttons.
explanation.definitionFit: These button-covered London figures are a colourful spectacle at fairs and charity events, so a sight to see.

clue.text: Touched on commercial about dairy spread that's yet to be finished

indicators.note: the advert word sits around the shortened spread

parts.note: an ad is a commercial

indicators.note: the spread lacks its final letter, so it is not finished

parts.note: butter is a spread made from cream

explanation.surface: An advert mentioned a half-made dairy spread.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's yet to be finished' drops the last letter of BUTTER to leave BUTTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Land that touched on another plot bordered it, which is what this past-tense verb means.

clue.text: See second container?

parts.note: a pot is a container

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to look at another box.
explanation.definitionFit: To spot something is to catch sight of it, the same as seeing it.

clue.text: Extent of public notice for data collection

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a file is a collection of data

explanation.surface: How widely something is known determines how data gets gathered.
explanation.definitionFit: A high public standing means wide attention, so it measures how much notice someone gets.

clue.text: Posed holding revolutionary bag

indicators.note: the word for posed contains the revolutionary's name

parts.note: a model sat for, or posed for, a portrait
Che Guevara is the classic crossword revolutionary

explanation.surface: A model posed clutching a radical's handbag.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sealed pouch, often holding sugar or shampoo, is a little bag.

clue.text: What bereaved do with second container for ashes

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second
an urn holds cremated ashes

explanation.surface: Mourners keep a second vessel for a loved one's remains.
explanation.definitionFit: Grieving for someone who has died is what the bereaved do.

clue.text: Plot with hollow lime tree

parts.note: to plot a course is to map it

indicators.note: a hollow word keeps only its outer letters

explanation.surface: A gardener plots out a lime tree that is hollow.
explanation.walkthrough: The lime tree in the surface hides the true tree.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a broad-leaved tree whose leaf appears on the Canadian flag.

clue.text: Be very dear and try entering downland valley

indicators.note: the word for try goes into the valley word

parts.note: a coomb is a short valley on the chalk downs of southern England
to have a stab is to have a try

explanation.surface: Something precious tries entering a dip in the hills.
explanation.walkthrough: COOMB is a southern English word for a small valley in chalk downland.
explanation.definitionFit: The British idiom for being extremely expensive is to cost an enormous sum.

clue.text: Water slide is very appealing when it's hot inside

indicators.note: the letter for hot is placed inside the word for appealing

parts.note: cute means very appealing
h is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A water slide is lovely in hot weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A slope down which swimmers slide into a pool is a sloping channel of the same name.

clue.text: Aromatic fragrance knocked caliph out

indicators.note: something knocked about is battered out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A scent so strong it laid out a Muslim ruler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' belongs to the fodder, not the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: This oil from an Asian plant of the mint family gives a heavy, musky perfume.

clue.text: What's poetic greeting heard the country over?

indicators.note: the greeting is said out loud and spelt by its sound

parts.note: hi is a greeting

indicators.note: over means the letters are turned round

parts.note: UK is the United Kingdom

explanation.surface: A riddle about what greeting is heard throughout the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heard' makes HI into HAI, and 'over' turns UK into KU.
explanation.definitionFit: This short Japanese form of verse in three lines is a piece of poetry.

clue.text: Approve last one in 'unt?

parts.note: the end is the last part
in a hunt, h dropped as in Cockney speech, each mount is an 'orse, with the h dropped too

explanation.surface: A dropped-h voice backs the last rider out hunting.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe tells the solver to drop the H, as in Cockney speech.
explanation.definitionFit: To give one's backing or sanction to something is to approve it.

clue.text: Go to put on weight, giving up following diet initially

indicators.note: the weight word gives up the letter for following

parts.note: to fatten is to put on weight
f is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

indicators.note: take the first letter of diet

explanation.surface: A dieter must stop gaining weight after starting a diet.
explanation.definitionFit: To be present at an event, such as a meeting, is to go to it.
